text_block_list.text:
One day, while I'm out with Super
Creek...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Look over there! It's filled with so many
cute
plushies
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
I look in the direction Супер Крик is
pointing and
see a claw machine filled
with stuffed
Umamusume toys.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, they're so cute. I just want to take
care of
all of them!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
But I've never really tried these machines
before...
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
A troubled look spreads across Super
Creek's
face.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Do you want me to win you one?

text_block_list.text:
Really? You'd do that for me? Well, if
you're
offering, then I gratefully accept!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text:
Good luck! Oh, but don't push yourself
too hard,
okay? That's a big no-no!
text_block_list.name: Супер Крик

text_block_list.text: There's no way I can fail!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
